SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of ONE heart stud: its mosaic of upright clear baguettes, the tiny gold beads and the smooth rim, resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the piece fills about two thirds of the frame; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the rest falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A PAIR OF HEART STUDS: each stud is ONE gold tone HEART with a smooth, rounded polished rim around a recessed panel set with ten clear stones standing upright in five columns, each in its own collet: a top row of five BAGUETTES and a bottom row of a small SQUARE, three baguettes and a small SQUARE; edged with tiny gold beads; a single post behind. One heart per stud; eight baguettes and two small squares, never round stones, never pave; smooth gold rim; never more than one stud per ear.

SCALE TEST: Each heart is about 14mm wide, a little wider than it is tall.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Only ONE earring is in this picture: its partner from the pair is NOT in frame, no second post, no second stone. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.

SHOT: A worn photograph: the model's hand raised and resting lightly on her collarbone, the ring finger forward, the camera close enough that the ring is clearly legible. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on the RING FINGER only (the fourth finger), the two clusters side by side across the top of the finger, one toward each side, facing each other over a narrow gap that runs along the finger: one cluster a clear PEAR beside a clear ROUND stone, the other two clear PEARS side by side with a row of tiny gold beads beside them, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN CLUSTER RING: a broad polished gold band about 4mm wide that does NOT close; each open end carries a small cluster of clear faceted stones in raised gold claws on a gold base, and the two clusters face each other across a narrow gap. One end: ONE clear PEAR beside ONE clear round stone. The other end: TWO clear PEAR stones side by side, their rounded ends together and their points turned outward, with a row of tiny gold beads along the edge of the band beside them. All stones clear. Only clear stones: one pear and one round on one end, two pears on the other; never coloured stones, never a full pave band, never a closed band.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the two clusters sit SIDE BY SIDE across the top of the finger, one toward each side of it, facing each other over a narrow gap that runs ALONG the finger; in each cluster the two stones line up along the finger, one nearer the knuckle and one nearer the nail; never one cluster in front of the other along the finger; each cluster about two thirds of the finger's width long, never wider than the finger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.

SHOT: Worn ring frame, 4:5: the BACK OF ONE HAND held up flat and square to camera in front of the collarbone, fingers together and relaxed, the camera brought close so the ring on the ring finger is legible at its true small size.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.
